about_short_description.short_description: Lower provides home refinancing, customer service, consumer lending, home purchase, and financial services.

product.name: Home Purchase Mortgages
product.description: Mortgage financing for purchasing primary residences, second homes, investment properties, condos, townhomes, multi-unit properties, and manufactured homes.

product.name: Mortgage Refinancing
product.description: Refinancing options that replace an existing mortgage to change the interest rate or term, reduce payments, access equity, or consolidate debt.

product.name: HELOC
product.description: A home equity line of credit that lets homeowners borrow against available equity for renovations, debt consolidation, education, or other expenses.

product.name: Home Equity Loans
product.description: Lump-sum loans secured by home equity for renovations, debt consolidation, and other large, one-time expenses.

product.name: Cash-Out Refinance
product.description: A refinance option that replaces an existing mortgage with a larger loan and provides the difference in cash, subject to available equity and approval.

product.name: Buy Before You Sell Program
product.description: Financing solutions that may help eligible homeowners purchase a new residence before selling their current home.
